title: ATR-barrier study, direction-only training: arm A's model (ARO inputs, tbatr, volume > 0) trained only on windows whose last bar hit a barrier -- S1, then S2 as a width-book sizer on p_buy
label: PROVISIONAL -- one era (2023-26). Expected ceiling ~0.55 (reference.json). Nothing is adopted or promoted.
why: 034's fixed-% triple-barrier model learned volatility (all-bar AUC 0.617 on its own label) but not direction where we trade (candidate AUC 0.525; 0.51 on tbatr) -- research/tb_model/check.json. The ATR-scaled label removes the volatility shortcut; 037 found direction signal on it (composite candidate AUC 0.554 / 0.552 vs ARO 0.541 / 0.539). Arm B asks whether those indicators help a model learn it.
label_definition: framework labels_triple_barrier / _sell with pt = sl = 1e-9, atr_scale 4.0 (ATR(14) Wilder), horizon 48, min_gain / min_loss None, post-label peak filter OFF (LABEL_PEAK_FILTER False, model-key attribute): BUY = up 4xATR first, SELL = down first, HOLD = timeout / tie. Checked before this file: equal to 037's label:tbatr_buy on SOL, 199,152 rows, 0 mismatches
training: per fold f00-f14, research.candidate_training.train --model TBD (seed 1, cs_aro's params snapshot); NNNC_CS_TBD = DirOnlyMixin + NNNC_CS_TBA; TRAIN_ROW_FILTER volume > 0 AND %tb_dir_keep (last bar labelled BUY or SELL), train and validation alike; everything else arm A's. Focal-loss class weights are computed by the trainer as before (HOLD count 0 -> weight 0, gamma 2.0 by its own rule).

s1.rows: test windows f00-f14, tradeable bars (data_ok AND volume > 0), label:tbatr_buy defined (timeouts / ties excluded)
s1.pass: median gbb-candidate AUC of p_buy above ARO's in BOTH halves (research/tb_model/dironly.py screen)
s1.reported: all-bar AUC; p_buy - p_sell readout; cs_tba_d's direction readout

s2.design: cs_aro's: p_buy as the capital-neutral width-book sizer, research/control_sizer/pick.py --plan plan_cs_tbd.json, 15-fold backtest
s2.instrument: research/xmodel_sizer/instrument.arm_check (cs_aro's checks; tag check against the arm's own test-window table signals/CS_TB?_fNN; entries without a score <= 1%)
s2.pass: cs_aro's bar: judge_one PASS vs w_aro AND wf_aro_g24 (small-margin rule)
s2.question: judge_one(cs_tbd, cs_aro); also reported: judge_one(cs_tbd, cs_tba_d) if cs_tba_d was backtested

small_margin_rule: if any primary half gain is < 1 pp, a PASS is INCONCLUSIVE
seen_before: 037 tbatr screens (all halves, all and tradeable bars), composite and its members
cs_aro, w_aro, wf_aro_g24, cs_arov, cs_cmp, cs_mix results
S1 on p_buy for TBA/TBB (both FAIL); direction readout S1 (cs_tba_d PASS 0.542/0.563, cs_tbb_d FAIL)
no TBD weights; cs_tba_d backtest may finish before or after this commit
question: trained on direction only, does the tbatr model beat ARO where we trade, and is it a better width-book sizer than cs_aro?
amends: Follows preregistration.json (69d250ae) and preregistration_dir.json (32c4d02a). Diagnostics (report.md, 3f3196a8): the 3-class model's p_buy tracks barrier hit; direction is learnable only to ~0.55-0.57 on these inputs (reference.json). User decision 2026-10-17: retrain on direction only.
